title: Understanding Internet & SaaS and Private Access Clouds

blocks.text: Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and Private Access (ZPA) have multi-cloud infrastructures. An organization is provisioned on one Internet & SaaS cloud, and its traffic is processed by that Internet & SaaS cloud only. For organizations that have Private Access, an organization is provisioned on one Private Access cloud, and its traffic is processed by that Private Access cloud only.

If you have multiple Internet & SaaS and Private Access tenants, any postures, machine tunnel tokens, and trusted networks you are using come from one Internet & SaaS tenant and one Private Access tenant. If users need access to both Internet & SaaS and Private Access, you can consolidate those users into a single Internet & SaaS tenant and a single Private Access tenant.

To learn more about Internet & SaaS and Private Access cloud architecture, and to find the name of your Internet & SaaS or Private Access cloud within the Zscaler Admin Console, see Understanding the ZIA Cloud Architecture, Understanding the Private Access Architecture, and Customizing Your Account Settings.

Within Experience Center, Internet & SaaS clouds (e.g., zscaler.net, zscalertwo.net, etc.) communicate with Private Access clouds (e.g., private.zscaler.com, zpatwo.net, etc.).
